algorithm.byte_order: big-endian for every multi-byte integer (network byte order)
algorithm.layout: message_id:16 || sent_at_ms:u64be || source_endpoint_len:u8 || source_endpoint || destination_endpoint_len:u8 || destination_endpoint || media_type_len:u8 || media_type || payload_len:u32be || payload
notes: message_id is exactly 16 bytes — 128 bits — never a printable form.
source_endpoint_len is 1..64: a source is always present, derived from the sender's lease and never caller-chosen.
destination_endpoint_len = 0 means the receiver's configured default endpoint, not an empty name and not fan-out.
media_type_len = 0 encodes ABSENCE; no empty media-type string exists on the wire.
payload_len is u32be and precedes the payload even when the payload is empty.
sent_at_ms is diagnostic: not authorization, ordering, freshness, replay-window, or dedup input.

$comment: Vectors are DERIVED from the layout decided in DIRECT.md — no ADR publishes a golden frame, so this file is anchored by its `adr` list rather than by a per-vector `frozen_by`. Byte order was unspecified until this fixture forced the question; DIRECT.md now pins big-endian, matching the IPC length prefix and the content fingerprint.

vectors.name: explicit-destination
vectors.description: The ordinary case: both endpoints present, a short text payload.

vectors.name: default-destination
vectors.description: destination_endpoint_len = 0 asks for the receiver's configured default endpoint. It is NOT an empty endpoint name, and never means fan-out.

vectors.name: absent-media-type
vectors.description: media_type_len = 0 encodes ABSENCE. No empty media-type string exists on the wire, and this maps to media_present=0 in the content fingerprint.

vectors.name: empty-payload
vectors.description: payload_len = 0 with the u32be length still present. An empty payload is legal; an empty media type is not.

vectors.name: max-endpoints-64
vectors.description: Both endpoint labels at the 64-byte ceiling, the widest legal single-byte length.

vectors.name: sent-at-ms-is-not-fingerprinted
vectors.description: Identical to explicit-destination except for sent_at_ms. The FRAME bytes differ; the content fingerprint does not — sent_at_ms is diagnostic only and excluded from dedup identity.
